racegeareu.text: Finals Czech SimRacing Series 2026 live stream - https://www.youtube.com/live/vLY-s5DRp_o?is=-uDJ9HoXpJ7MIB2u

Czech SimRacing Series 2026 — Grand Final in Prague: 𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐃𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐝 🏁

🏆 𝐓𝐖𝐎 𝐓𝐈𝐓𝐋𝐄𝐒. 𝐎𝐍𝐄 𝐂𝐇𝐀𝐌𝐏𝐈𝐎𝐍.

After two days of intense head-to-head racing at Prague Car Festival, Martin Štefanko has been crowned the 2026 Champion of the Czech Republic in Digital Motorsport.

He also claimed victory in the International category, finished first in the overall classification and sealed the weekend with a commanding 5–0 Grand Final win over Mate Mihalidesz.

🏆 Category podiums

𝐂𝐳𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩

1. Martin Štefanko
2. Lukáš Přáda
3. Adam Celárek

𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩

1. Martin Štefanko
2. Mate Mihalidesz
3. Lukáš Přáda

🏁 𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐓𝐎𝐏 𝟏𝟐

1. Martin Štefanko
2. Mate Mihalidesz
3. Lukáš Přáda
4. Adam Celárek
5. Vojtěch Polesný
6. Prokop Klimša
7. Marcell Morocz
8. Gabriel Csík
9. Balazs Palla
10. Jan Haladej
11. Máté Lampert
12. Gergő Gázser

13th–24th — joint classification, listed alphabetically:
David Bieroš, Vít Dvořák, Vojtěch Dvořák, Samuel Foniok, Daniel Klepal, Zsolt Nagy, Martin Nejedlík, Petr Otruba, David Toth, Martin Tóth, Lukáš Uhlík and Gian Zoutewelle.

The drivers competed for a prize pool worth more than €10,000, combining real-world motorsport experiences with professional sim-racing equipment.

Full official results, the knockout stage and prize allocation are available at racegear.eu.

Thank you to all 24 finalists for the clean battles, fair racing and competitive spirit.

A huge thank-you also goes to @f4_cez_academy , @praguecarfestival , @autoklub , @simucube , @bavariansimtec , @racing.journal , @proesportcz , @virtualgp , Křenek Motorsport and the entire organising team for making the Grand Final possible.

Special thanks to race director Martin Sirotek and sporting steward Vojtěch Fiala.
